study type: In vitro study with human sample analysis
cohort: The study utilized umbilical cord blood from patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and healthy controls, as well as human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs).
finding: The loss of exosomal circ_0074673 facilitated the proliferation, migration, and angiogenesis of high glucose-treated HUVECs (HG-HUVECs) via the miR-1200/MEOX2 axis.
cross-section timing: Umbilical cord blood samples were collected at birth.
